Sections.Name: Travel
Sections.Description: Relative weights for incoming visitor origins. Defaults are 60/35/5. Weights are normalized; all zero disables incoming origin discovery. Failed routes are skipped, so observed arrivals can differ. Nearby means the nearest sixteen supported settlements in the same region.

Keys.Name: NearbyOriginWeight
Keys.Description: Weight for nearby settlements in the same political region.

Keys.Name: DistantOriginWeight
Keys.Description: Weight for other settlements in the same region, outside the nearby group.

Keys.Name: ForeignOriginWeight
Keys.Description: Weight for origins in another political region. Race follows the hometown independently. A connected road route is required.

Sections.Name: Awareness
Sections.Description: Household access and theft detection in settlements. Disabling restores native behavior without deleting saved residents.

Keys.Name: HouseholdLocks
Keys.Description: Ordinary homes lock when no living awake owner is inside. Includes daytime absence. Owned/faction access stays native; explicit quest permissions are still in development.

Keys.Name: TheftWitnesses
Keys.Description: Unobserved theft always succeeds. Living awake nearby witnesses retain native skill checks; walls block sight and dead NPCs cannot witness theft. Disabling restores native theft probability.

Keys.Name: WitnessRange
Keys.Description: Maximum theft witness distance in metres. Sight must still be unobstructed. Applies to theft only, not combat or guard pursuit.

Sections.Name: General
Sections.Description: Development build with persistent families and scheduled adult visits. Children stay home; play, sleep poses and reactions remain in development.

Keys.Name: ExperimentalExteriorGuards
Keys.Description: Finite settlement guards: posts, physical response, combat and timed search/return. Missing approaches retain reported alarms until surveyed. Night patrol pairs carry torches. Wall patrols remain in development.

Keys.Name: CivilianReactions
Keys.Description: Generated residents flee or counterattack; children flee. Direct witnesses warn at most two people. With finite guards enabled, indoor witnesses must reach a guard before reporting; outdoor witnesses report locally. Missing paths do not create immediate guard knowledge. Stationary NPC reactions remain in development.

Keys.Name: QuestHouseholds
Keys.Description: Pilot: bind new vanilla The Delivery Boy recipients to existing Gothway Garden households. Other quests keep native behavior. Disabling stops new bindings; already accepted names and quest targets remain stable.

Keys.Name: Enabled
Keys.Description: Enable population updates. Disabling keeps saved residents and deaths; schedules catch up when re-enabled.

Keys.Name: StreetPopulation
Keys.Description: Adult visits and family interior presence using classic sprites in cities, towns and villages. Replaces random street civilians while active. Children stay home until play and movement animations are ready.

Sections.Name: Guards
Sections.Description: Controls the experimental guard preview in the exterior and surveyed interiors. Existing roster identities and deaths remain saved when settings change.

Keys.Name: NightTorches
Keys.Description: Visible exterior guards carry classic animated torches at night. Torches turn off by day, indoors and on death.

Keys.Name: DayPatrols
Keys.Description: Pairs from the day shift walk surveyed street circuits between 06:00 and 18:00. Turning this off sends patrols physically back to their posts.

Keys.Name: NightPatrols
Keys.Description: Pairs from the night shift walk surveyed street circuits between 18:00 and 06:00. Turning this off sends patrols physically back to their posts.

Keys.Name: EnemyDefense
Keys.Description: Finite exterior guards defend against visible hostile creatures and attackers, including quest-owned foes. Disabling sends defenders physically back to posts.

Keys.Name: MaximumPatrolPairs
Keys.Description: Cap on two-person patrols per active shift. About one third of ordinary staff patrol; a tiny village uses one pair and one fixed post. Gate staff are additional. Zero disables patrols; unusable circuits leave guards posted.

Keys.Name: TorchLightLimit
Keys.Description: Maximum nearest guard torches emitting real light within 48 metres. Zero keeps visible flames without dynamic lighting. Lights cast no shadows.

Keys.Name: TorchRange
Keys.Description: Guard torch light radius in metres.

Keys.Name: MaximumResponders
Keys.Description: Maximum available guards assigned to each new report. Repeated reports do not add more guards; guards attacked directly can still defend themselves.

Keys.Name: ActorRadius
Keys.Description: Distance in metres for visible guard bodies. Travel continues outside this radius. Engaged guards stay active until pursuit ends.

Sections.Name: DailyRoutine
Sections.Description: Hours use the 24-hour clock. Controls home/sleep schedules and experimental bed poses; changes apply immediately.

Keys.Name: SleepingPoses
Keys.Description: Complete single-sleeper poses, one NPC per bed. Appearance coverage remains incomplete. Turning this off restores standing sprites without changing schedules or saved identities.

Keys.Name: WakeHour
Keys.Description: Hour residents wake at home.

Keys.Name: SleepHour
Keys.Description: Hour residents go to sleep at home.

Sections.Name: Dialogue
Sections.Description: Local free-text conversation with native topic knowledge, validated map requests and personal disposition. Type in the word-wrapped editor in the classic Talk window. Requires the local dialogue service at 127.0.0.1:8080/completion.

Keys.Name: EnableFreeText
Keys.Description: Enable the word-wrapped text editor for talkable NPCs. Requires a compatible local llama.cpp server at 127.0.0.1:8080/completion.

Keys.Name: PrewarmModel
Keys.Description: After game starts, load local model on background worker. Gameplay never waits for this request.

Keys.Name: EnableNpcVoice
Keys.Description: Enable optional local NPC speech. Does not require local dialogue or D3. Uses the user-owned breeze-tts.json bridgeRoot and loopback serverEndpoint under the persistent-data PeopleOfTheIliacBay folder.

Keys.Name: EnableAnimatedPortraits
Keys.Description: Animate available NPC portraits with emotional expressions, blinking and occasional sideways glances. Validated speech cues animate the mouth during voice playback. Unsupported portraits retain their original image.

Keys.Name: EnableSocialSentenceStreaming
Keys.Description: Legacy streaming only: speak validated sentence segments while an eligible social LLM reply is arriving. Requires EnableNpcVoice, the local streaming TTS coordinator, and the -peopleoftheiliacbay-allow-legacy-speech-streaming launch flag. This setting alone keeps finalized prepared playback enabled.

Keys.Name: ConversationDisposition
Keys.Description: Enable native disposition changes from eligible conversation tone outcomes. Insults reduce disposition by 10 the first time and 25 on later insults; rude tone reduces it by 2. Distinct polite lines earn gradual goodwill, capped at 5 per encounter; repeated lines do not count again. Credit accrues on nominal 24/30/36-hour stages with a stable person-specific 85–115% rate factor and a 36-hour actual-interval cap.

Keys.Name: DispositionCommerce
Keys.Description: Apply personal disposition prices and service refusal to supported native merchant trades, repairs, identification, tavern food and rooms, and paid guild services. Requires ConversationDisposition. Disable to retain native prices and eligibility rules while keeping conversation reactions and saved relationships.

Keys.Name: MapRequests
Keys.Description: Allow explicit free-text map requests for real known local buildings. Native knowledge and indoor restrictions still apply.

Keys.Name: TimeoutMilliseconds
Keys.Description: Maximum wait for each local-model HTTP stage in milliseconds. CPU inference can need much longer than the GPU default; failure or timeout shows a safe non-factual fallback.

Sections.Name: Diagnostics
Sections.Description: Development controls. These affect diagnostic refresh, not walking speed.

Keys.Name: RefreshSeconds
Keys.Description: Seconds between settlement and diagnostic updates.

Keys.Name: EnableF8Panel
Keys.Description: Allow F8 to toggle the population diagnostic panel.
